title: Version 17.11.1
body_markdown:
*Released August 20th, 2024*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| Visual Studio 2022 (64-bit) Version 17.11.0 Preview 6.0 corrupts stack on stopping debugging a native application. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Visual-Studio-2022-64-bit-Version-171/10715642 "Feedback ticket for Visual Studio 2022 (64-bit) Version 17.11.0 Preview 6.0 corrupts stack on stopping debugging a native application") |
| Xamarin Profiler has been deprecated and removed from Visual Studio. |  |
| Xamarin.Android Designer is scheduled for deprecation and will be removed in a future update. |  |

---

Tip

If there are any features you'd like to see in future updates to Visual Studio, please let us know by [submitting a feature ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/VisualStudio/suggest?ref=vs_releasenotes).

Note

Our [roadmap](/en-us/visualstudio/productinfo/vs-roadmap) shows the priorities and direction for the future of Visual Studio, so make sure to check it out.

Note

From all of us on the team, thank you for choosing Visual Studio. If you have any questions, please reach us on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/VisualStudio) or [Developer Community](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/VisualStudio?ref=vs_releasenotes).

**Happy coding!**  
*The Visual Studio team*
